Partner Variables Node Update!! 

Update with your Partner ID from within SaaS Alerts. Settings > API > Show Partner ID.

Update PartnerName to your MSP Name as it is in SaaS Alerts

Update your API Key - Settings > API > API Key

Gmail SMTP

Add in your own credentials for your Gmail SMTP Relay. Free and easy to use. Gmail 2FA required. Follow these steps: 

Generate a Gmail App Password:

Go to myaccount.google.com
Click Security in the left nav
Under "How you sign in to Google" make sure 2-Step Verification is enabled (app passwords require this)
Search for "App passwords" in the search bar at the top of the page
Give it a name (e.g. "n8n SaaS Alerts")
Click Create — Google generates a 16-character password
Copy it immediately — you won't see it again

Configure in n8n:

Click the Gmail SMTP node
Open the credentials
Set:

User: your full Gmail address
Password: the 16-character app password (no spaces)
Host: smtp.gmail.com
Port: 465 (SSL) or 587 (TLS)
SSL/TLS: enabled


Save and test

Steps for creating the App Registration

Go to portal.azure.com
Search for App registrations → New registration
Name it something like n8n Vacation Form
Supported account types: Single tenant (your org only) or Multitenant depending on your MSP setup
Redirect URI: Web → https://[your-n8n-instance].app.n8n.cloud/webhook/auth/callback
Click Register

Once registered grab:

Application (client) ID — on the overview page
Directory (tenant) ID — on the overview page
Client Secret — go to Certificates & Secrets → New client secret

Once the above is done, make the below adjustments

Update: tenant_id in Build MS Auth URL node
Update: client_id in Build MS Auth URL node and HTTP Exchange Code node
Update: client_secret (Value) in HTTP Exchange Code node
Update: redirect_uri in HTTP Exchange Code node to match your n8n instance URL

**Redirect URIs in Azure Portal to match your n8n instance URL
